title: Lowkey.. you don’t need to understand every detail of the formula to use it #engineeringdegree
transcript: Things to think about when you're studying maths and some reassurance as well. You are not a mathematician, you're not a math mathematics student, you are an engineer, an engineering student. Stop worrying about the derivations and the proofs. That's their job, not ours. For us, maths is a tool. We use it to create real things. We do not care about derivations and proofs. That's why we're studying an engineering degree. And I'm here to remind you of that. And it is okay to look at the like the principles, the proofs of how differentiation and integration became a thing. It's okay to not understand this, okay? You need to understand how to use it to build stuff, make stuff.
